title: bn254-gt-dlp: Pure-Scalar C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS with sigma-Folded 12D Band-3, 8-Lane SWAR sb_u7, Score-Only Stage B, & Fixed-Instance H3 4-Cap Z[omega] LA: 2^86.548991570

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-gt-dlp target, the self-contained 100% pure-scalar AArch64 algorithm of proof.md (C6-m184_w216-rec content-reduced reciprocal CM-sextic tower, order-6 Frobenius tau = Frob^10, exact rational sigma(w) == w twist invariance, score-only 3-band g-side sieving at B_f = 2^61, B_g = 2^60, excess 0.82: Band-1 [2^14, 2^44) unrolled-4 apply + early4_find, Band-2 [2^44, 2^53) 8-lane 64-bit SWAR sb_u7 per-SB tight q_min_j gate, Band-3 [2^53, 2^59) sigma-orbit-folded 12D Ellipsoid Fincke-Pohst walk on 1/3 as many ideals with exact 12D Gaussian-volume scaling, uint16_t 64-bit SWAR scan+zero, 100% score-only Stage B stripping the exact 2^14-smooth part m via 417 64-bit prime-product chunks with ZERO sieve prime recording, live norm-histogram-weighted full de Bruijn rho_dB, un-discounted Schirokauer maps, 1-owner 3-bucket Z[omega] Block Wiedemann with deterministic pre-merge guard W_avg <= 161.0 and 4-parameter hard caps (N_sw_cap = 0.00160*U', N_l_cap = 0.00098*U', k5_cap = 12.00, tab_r_cap = 0.85, lazy = 0) under fixed-instance premise H3, and live 62-row LB=59 pure QBINS/BOOT_BINS 12D descent using min_k(P(M < k) + psi^k)) returns x with g^x = z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64) * 2^87.903225261 <= 2^86.548991570 units (C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under declared exploratory heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, and H-SEP (proof.md Section 6 and RANK-BRIDGE.md). A run gate opens the run iff a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7215306097858570014, the least integer with (K/2^64) * 0.997079 >= 0.39; a closed run fails at cost 1 unit. Opened-run success >= 0.997079 is bounded by a strict additive union bound (FIX-U). Neither finite-scale simulator outcomes nor sample confidence intervals are substituted for the attack's production success probability. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification, and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized.
